headline: Congress extended the New Jersey Coastal Heritage Trail Route program through fiscal year 2025.
what_it_does: The law renews the New Jersey Coastal Heritage Trail Route, a network of trails and sites along the state's coast, so it can keep operating through fiscal year 2025. The official summary does not describe any new rules, spending amounts, or changes beyond extending the program's time limit.

who_it_affects.group: Visitors to the New Jersey Coastal Heritage Trail Route
who_it_affects.how: The trail route and its sites stay in place as a recognized program for the extended period.

who_it_affects.group: Local governments and groups that manage sites along the trail
who_it_affects.how: They can continue participating in the program through fiscal year 2025 under the renewed authorization.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 10, 2019, and the program authorization runs through fiscal year 2025.
